events.headline: Helsing launches Clarity battlefield intelligence software
events.summary: Helsing introduced Clarity, an AI software system combining drone, satellite and other battlefield data using specialized agents. The company has not disclosed customer deployments, and human operators retain strike approval.

events.headline: Researchers say AI agents aided theft of Tajik government documents
events.summary: CloudSek attributed a theft of more than 2,000 Tajik government documents to a Kazakhstan-linked group that reportedly used the Hermes agent framework. The attribution and technical details are researchers' findings, not independently confirmed government findings.

events.headline: CoreWeave earnings ease fears over AI cloud financing
events.summary: CoreWeave raised its annual revenue outlook and said contracted cash flows could cover debt payments. Its shares and other AI infrastructure names rallied, although analysts warned of vulnerability if compute demand weakens.

events.headline: UK AI inference chip startup Fractile raises $720 million
events.summary: Fractile raised $720 million at a reported $7 billion valuation to develop inference chips promising faster and more efficient model serving. Its first commercial chip is planned for 2027; performance claims are not yet independently benchmarked.

events.headline: US stocks rebound as AI infrastructure shares rally
events.summary: The S&P 500 gained 1.31% and Nasdaq rose 1.60% Wednesday, helped by CoreWeave and semiconductor shares. Investors continued to weigh AI infrastructure financing and expectations of a December Federal Reserve rate hike.

events.headline: Asian equities fall as Nvidia leadership uncertainty hits chips
events.summary: Nvidia fell as much as 8.8% after hours amid reports its board was considering replacing CEO Jensen Huang. Taiwan and other Asian equity benchmarks declined as investors weighed AI concentration and governance risks; no board decision was confirmed.

events.headline: Oil swings as Middle East tensions offset rising supply
events.summary: Oil reversed early losses and rose by 0732 GMT as geopolitical tensions supported prices despite recovering regional production and higher US inventories. Reuters reported Brent at $93.21 and WTI at $86.80 at that time.
